title: wrangler dev --test-scheduled fires cronFired on the fixture handler at the CLI seam
asA: reviewer verifying platform-cloudflare-cron-triggers v1.0.0 at mechanism reach
iWant: the wrangler-test-scheduled probe to spawn wrangler dev --test-scheduled on the cf-platform fixture, drive its scheduled-fire route with a cron expression declared in wrangler.toml, assert a cronFired event fires and wrangler exits cleanly
soThat: the shipped scheduled() handler is proven wired to the vendor's CLI seam, not only to an in-process spy

acceptanceCriteria.description: The wrangler-test-scheduled probe spawns wrangler dev --test-scheduled from the cf-platform fixture, waits bounded 30 seconds for the CLI to bind, drives its scheduled-fire endpoint with an expression declared in wrangler.toml, asserts a cronFired event fires on the injected sink with metadata {event, expression, scheduledTime, outcome, duration}, kills wrangler cleanly on exit, and returns aggregateVerdict: pass. On a shipped wrangler regression that prevents --test-scheduled from binding, the probe returns aggregateVerdict: warn with the observed stderr quoted and the mechanism-reach gap noted; the CI does not gate on warn.
acceptanceCriteria.given: wrangler installed as a devDependency on the cf-platform fixture and the [triggers] crons block declared in wrangler.toml
acceptanceCriteria.when: the probe runs from the fixture directory
acceptanceCriteria.then: wrangler dev --test-scheduled binds, the scheduled-fire route drives a cronFired event, wrangler exits cleanly, and the probe returns pass (or warn on a documented CLI regression)

acceptanceCriteria.description: CI gate on bind or fire failures: the probe harness at packages/rcf-lite/test/blueprint/platform-cloudflare-cron-triggers-anatomy.test.js treats aggregateVerdict !== "pass" (including "warn" AND "fail") as a hard gate failure and exits non-zero. The prior "the CI does not gate on warn" clause is removed from AC-32105-1. A wrangler regression that would otherwise return warn now surfaces as a red CI check on the branch, per the operator ruling that documented failure paths are ACs, not warnings.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the probe harness invoked from packages/rcf-lite/test/blueprint under Node 24
acceptanceCriteria.when: the probe returns aggregateVerdict warn or fail
acceptanceCriteria.then: the anatomy test asserts verdict === "pass" and exits non-zero on any other value

acceptanceCriteria.description: Bounded-wait timeout: if wrangler dev --test-scheduled does not bind within the 30-second cap, the probe kills the child, records the observed stderr and returns aggregateVerdict:"fail" with a reason field naming CRON_WRANGLER_BIND_TIMEOUT. Under AC-32105-2 the CI harness treats this as a hard failure.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a probe run where wrangler cannot bind within 30 seconds (simulated by an invalid PORT or a stubbed missing binary)
acceptanceCriteria.when: the probe caps the wait at 30 seconds
acceptanceCriteria.then: the probe returns aggregateVerdict "fail" with reason CRON_WRANGLER_BIND_TIMEOUT and the observed stderr

acceptanceCriteria.description: Wrangler exits non-zero mid-run: if the wrangler child exits with a non-zero code during the probe (crash after bind), the probe surfaces the observed exit code and stderr and returns aggregateVerdict:"fail". Under AC-32105-2 the CI harness treats this as a hard failure.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a probe run where wrangler crashes after binding (simulated by SIGTERM injection)
acceptanceCriteria.when: the probe observes the child exit
acceptanceCriteria.then: aggregateVerdict is "fail" with the exit code and stderr in the reason field

acceptanceCriteria.description: Probe teardown: the probe kills the wrangler child on exit (normal or exceptional) via SIGTERM followed by SIGKILL after a 2-second grace period. A test that interrupts the probe with a rejection at the assertion step still observes the wrangler child terminated within 3 seconds.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a probe run that is interrupted by an assertion rejection after the CLI binds
acceptanceCriteria.then: the wrangler child is terminated within 3 seconds; no orphan process remains
